jobs.prompt: T50 (decision #159, contract §1 job t50-card): build HoloCard component, holoCard.css styles, holoCardState.ts state logic, plus unit and component tests. Build exactly what §2–§4 specifies. Key picks: (1) No new npm dependencies; tilt is custom pointer math in holoCardState (±12° hover clamp, zero-crossing snap); (2) drag-to-rotate in v1 (left-mouse Y-axis ±180°, snap back if not flipped); (3) foil = CSS-only (linear + conic gradients, glare-x/glare-y custom properties, sparkle from ONE 2D canvas rendered at module load, data-URL ~50KB, no per-frame work); (4) gold border = CSS engraved (inset box-shadows, Lantern tokens); (5) IntersectionObserver threshold 0.25; (6) portrait fallback when !visible || !hovered (static , no animation); (7) reduced-motion: no tilt/glare, flip instant, no sparkle; (8) keyboard focus = hover visual, Enter/Space flip, Tab reaches Pick; (9) three mutants killed: card animates while page hidden, back shows before flip, static fallback missing. HoloCard.tsx: React component, ~140–180 lines. Props: portrait (CoworkerImage | undefined), name (string), category (string | null), moreMotion (boolean), onPick (() => void), visible (boolean), reduced (boolean from matchMedia). Renders front (portrait + foil + border) and back (name, category, More-motion tag if moreMotion, Pick button) faces. Calls useHoloCardState to track pointer/visibility/reduced-motion. Applies data attributes [data-hovered], [data-visible], [data-reduced], [data-flipped] driven by holoCardState return values. ARIA: role="article", aria-label on card and Pick button. holoCard.css: ~200 lines. 3D perspective, preserve-3d. Front/back faces rotateY for flip. Foil = linear + conic gradients, opacity layers, mask by --glare-x/--glare-y (0–100 custom properties). Gold border = 2–3 inset box-shadows with --oasis-needs-you and --oasis-rim. Tilt = rotateX/rotateY from --tilt-x/--tilt-y (degrees, 0 when not hovered or not visible). Flip transition 400–600ms. Reduced-motion: no transition, no tilt, no glare, no sparkle. Static fallback class holo-card__fallback (no 3D). holoCardState.ts: ~140 lines, pure module, no React, no external dependencies. Export useHoloCardState(element: HTMLElement | null, visible: boolean, reduced: boolean) => { flipped: boolean, hovered: boolean, tiltX: number, tiltY: number, dragRotY: number, toggleFlip: () => void }. Track IntersectionObserver (visible gate), matchMedia prefers-reduced-motion (reduced gate), pointermove/enter/leave (tilt math: clamp (x - center.x) / width to ±12°, same Y), pointerdown+move with primary button (drag: (x_move - x_down) / width * 180 for dragRotY, up to ±180°, snap back on leave if not flipped), visibilitychange (page hidden = stop animation). CSS custom properties --tilt-x, --tilt-y (degrees), --glare-x, --glare-y (0–100), --drag-rot-y (degrees). Animation gates: set all to 0 if !visible || !hovered || reduced. Sparkle: at module load, create 2D canvas (64×64), render tiny circles in a glitter pattern (procedural, deterministic), convert to data-URL, export as sparkleDataUrl (reused by CSS). Tests: vitest + jsdom + RTL. Mock IntersectionObserver (vi.stubGlobal), matchMedia (vi.mocked), requestAnimationFrame (jsdom default), pointer events (fireEvent.pointerenter, pointerdown, pointermove, pointerup, pointerleave). Fake CoworkerImage with thumb kind. Tests in holoCard.test.tsx: (1) front face renders (portrait, name, badge, More-motion tag if present); (2) Space/Enter flips to back; (3) Space/Enter again flips back; (4) visible=false → static PNG fallback rendered; (5) hovered=false → no animation, static falls back; (6) reduced=true → no transition, instant flip, no tilt/glare classes; (7) focus shows hover visual; (8) Pick button is real
